evals.prompt: Render a two-camera animation to EXR sequences and a review MP4 with an explicit color pipeline.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Verifies decoded outputs and expected frame continuity instead of operator return.
Records actual device and effective resolution plus color/alpha/pass metadata.
Compares representative rendered detail and temporal behavior.

evals.prompt: A batch says success but MP4 is absent, frames are missing and a denoiser erases hair. Diagnose and rerender affected outputs.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis tied to the supplied failure, preserved sources, a concrete correction and repeated affected acceptance checks.
assertions: Verifies decoded outputs and expected frame continuity instead of operator return.
Records actual device and effective resolution plus color/alpha/pass metadata.
Compares representative rendered detail and temporal behavior.
Does not label a hypothetical plan, a structural assertion or unrun workflow as successful execution.
